It provides easy installation for electricians. The heat sink is also made of aluminium injection. SUNSHINE is an excellent fixture for housing and residencies. IP44 is optional. Therefore it is ideal for shower gaps, bathrooms, outdoors, eaves and all indoors. SUNSHINE is favoured for having available dimensions for every possible space due to 6 different types.

products.desc: KAIRA-S is a square movable headed COB led downlight which has an aluminium injection cage. It comes with single and double options. Since mounting hole on the ceiling is circular it provides easy installation for electricians. Its frame is coated with electrostatic powder. It can be painted in any colour within Ral catalogue. The heat sink is also made of aluminium injection. It does not only help led pcb cool down but also increases life span of the led. Therefore it is ideal for shower gaps, bathrooms, outdoors, eaves and all indoors. KAIRA-S is favoured for having available dimensions for every possible space due to alternative model. It is usually opted for stores because of 180 degree movable head.

products.desc: KAIRA-S is a square movable headed COB led downlight which has an aluminium injection cage. It comes with single and double options. Since mounting hole on the ceiling is circular it provides easy installation for electricians. Its frame is coated with electrostatic powder. It can be painted in any colour within Ral catalogue. The heat sink is also made of aluminium injection. It does not only help led pcb cool down but also increases life span of the led. Therefore it is ideal for shower gaps, bathrooms, outdoors, eaves and all indoors. KAIRA-S is favoured for having available dimensions for every possible space due to alternative model. It is usually opted for stores because of 180 degree movable head.

products.desc: NOELANI OP has an aluminium injection cage which is custom designed as over plaster circular COB led downlight. Its frame is coated with electrostatic powder. Its frame is made of aluminium. The heat sink is also made of aluminium injection. It does not only help led pcb cool down but also increases life span of the led. High lumen power in low watts ensures spacious and elegant ambiance at each location. NOELANI OP is an excellent downlight for housing and residencies. IP44 is optional. Therefore it is ideal for shower gaps, bathrooms, outdoors, eaves and all indoors. NOELANI is favoured for having available dimensions for every possible space due to 5 different types.
